mapper.sql: g.id, g.code_id, g.code_name, g.description, g.used_yn, g.created_at, g.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM com_code_group g WHERE g.id = #{id}

where.if: AND (LOWER(g.code_id) LIKE LOWER(#{keyword}) ESCAPE '!' OR g.code_name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_code_group (code_id, code_name, description, used_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{codeId}, #{codeName}, #{description}, #{used}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
